widgets_description: Manage which widgets appear on your dashboard. Click the header to toggle.

widget_info_mining_balance: Shows your current accumulated mining balance and pending payouts. This is the total amount of tokens you've earned from domain mining.
widget_info_total_domains: Displays the total number of domains you own, how many are actively mining, and how many are not yet verified.
widget_info_total_earned: Shows the total amount of tokens you've earned from all your domains since you started mining.
widget_info_account_info: Displays your account information including username, email, and wallet address. You can set your wallet here to receive payouts.
widget_info_your_statistics: Shows your personal mining statistics including total domains and how many are currently mining.
widget_info_domain_health_warnings: Alerts you about domains that need attention: expiring soon, failed verification checks, or pending verification. Helps you maintain your mining operations.
widget_info_quick_alerts: Quick notifications about important items that need your attention: wallet not configured (required for payouts), pending payout requests being processed, domains expiring soon (need renewal), domains with failed verification checks (need fixing), and domains waiting for verification. Helps you stay on top of critical actions.
widget_info_system_wide_statistics: Network-wide statistics showing total users, domains, active mining operations, and total rewards distributed across the entire system.
widget_info_mining_performance: Performance metrics for your mining operations including average daily and weekly earnings, plus breakdown of confirmed, pending, and failed rewards.
widget_info_top_earning_domains: Shows which of your domains are earning the most tokens. Helps you identify your most profitable domains.
widget_info_earnings_charts: Visual charts showing your earnings over time. Daily earnings for the last 30 days and weekly earnings for the last 12 weeks.
widget_info_payout_settings: Your payout configuration including payout mode (manual or auto), auto-payout threshold, and last payout information.
widget_info_payout_history: History of all your payout requests showing amounts, dates, status (completed, processing, failed), and transaction IDs.
widget_info_recent_rewards: List of your most recent reward transactions showing which domains earned tokens, when, and the status of each reward.
widget_info_recent_domains: Quick view of your domains showing their verification status and mining state. Click to view all domains.
